title: Anthropic solves Jacobian Conjecture using Fable 5 #anthropic #jacobianconjecture #mathematics
description: Anthropic solved the 87-year-old Jacobian Conjecture using Claude Fable 5 during the FIFA World Cup final. This breakthrough provided a concrete counterexample disproving the conjecture, a problem that had remained unsolved since 1939 alongside monumental challenges like the Riemann Hypothesis. Unlike previous attempts that failed or remained unverifiable, the counterexample is concise enough to be independently checked on Wolfram Alpha in under a minute, and mathematicians verified its validity within hours. This represents a landmark moment in mathematical research, showcasing how AI can accelerate discovery by tackling historically intractable problems. The use of Claude Fable 5 highlights a significant shift in the scientific community where AI doesn’t just assist but leads to groundbreaking insights. It demonstrates AI’s potential to transform complex theoretical fields with accessible and verifiable results, ultimately reshaping mathematical exploration and problem-solving methods. #Anthropic #ClaudeFable5 #JacobianConjecture #FIFAWorldCup #Mathematics #AIResearch #MathBreakthrough #NumberTheory #WolframAlpha #MathDisproof #ArtificialIntelligence #MathInnovation #ScientificDiscovery #MathProblemSolved #AIinScience
